Photo 1 shows the front of the laptop with the screen open, keyboard, touchpad, and 'DELL' logo above the screen.

risks.risk: The laptop may not have an Intel Core i5 7th generation processor.
risks.proof: A photo of the BIOS screen or system information showing the CPU model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having an unknown or lower-generation CPU

risks.risk: The RAM may not be 8GB or may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the system information screen showing installed RAM or a photo of the RAM slots with modules.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having less than 8GB or faulty RAM

risks.risk: The battery may not have good life or may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the laptop running on battery with battery percentage and time remaining.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having poor or no battery life

risks.risk: The screen may be cracked, dead pixels, or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the screen turned on, displaying a clear image.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a non-functional or damaged screen

risks.risk: The laptop may have internal damage or non-working components (keyboard, ports, etc.).
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop powered on, keyboard typing, ports in use, and all functions working.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown or non-working internal components

proof_requests: Video or photo of the laptop powered on with screen displaying clearly.
Photo of the BIOS or system information screen showing CPU model and RAM.
Video showing the laptop running on battery with battery percentage and time.
Photo of the RAM slots or system information confirming 8GB RAM.
Video showing keyboard, touchpad, and ports working.
response.reason: The model is identifiable as Dell Latitude 3580, but key claims about CPU generation, RAM, battery life, and functionality cannot be verified from the photos. Without proof of these, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries significant hidden risks.
